newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Maize, milling wheat futures mixed in Budapest mkt.
newsitem.headline: Maize, milling wheat futures mixed in Budapest mkt.

text.p: Milling wheat and maize futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange closed mixed on Thursday.
March and May milling wheat futures rose in heavy turnover on position-closing by previous sellers.
"Speculators who sold for March have to close their positions this week if they don't want to deliver," said Janos Szojka of Swap ugynoki Kft.
The March maturity finished at 26,800 forints, up 450, while May milling wheat closed at 24,390, up up 440.
September, October and December milling wheat eased by 80 to 100 forints in what traders said was the volatile Hungarian market's over-reaction to a slight drop in international prices.
"There was no fresh news, wheat followed the world market trend," Szojka said.
Maize traders focused on position-closing in the March maturity.
March maize futures firmed to 18,700 forints during the session from Wednesday's closing of 18,300, but eased again when the buying wave passed and finished down at 18,200 forints.
Lot size is 20,000 kgs for all contracts.
